title: Darkwing's Tweaks - Server-side Fullbright
body:
Also made in MCreator, the second Darkwing's Tweaks:
Fullbright for server-side Minecraft, for every player!

This is a download once data pack that when downloaded, gives every player Night Vision, without any particles.

So do you hate dark caves, but don't want torches? This is the Data Pack for YOUR Singleplayer World or Server!

Note: I do not claim any rights over the term 'Fullbright'.
